name: L-sit
description: A support hold on straight arms with the legs held straight out in front. It combines shoulder depression with hip compression strength.

steps.label: Support hold
steps.cue: Arms locked, shoulders pushed down away from your ears.

steps.label: Foot supported L-sit
steps.cue: Lift your hips while your heels stay on the floor.

steps.label: Tuck L-sit
steps.cue: Pull your knees up and keep pushing the floor away.

steps.label: One leg L-sit
steps.cue: Switch the straight leg each set and lock that knee.

steps.label: L-sit on parallettes
steps.cue: Legs straight and together at hip height.

steps.label: L-sit on the floor
steps.cue: Push down hard and lift your heels clear of the floor.
